mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.device_id, r.address, r.is_open AS opened, r.is_lock AS locked, r.lock_status, r.delay_time, r.create_at, r.update_at, r.delete_at FROM access_record r WHERE r.device_id = #{device_id} AND r.delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.create_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.device_id, r.address, r.self_id, r.is_open AS opened, r.mode, r.temperature, r.speed, r.room_temperature, r.error_code, r.create_at, r.update_at, r.delete_at FROM air_condition_record r WHERE r.device_id = #{device_id} AND r.delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.create_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.device_id, r.address, r.is_open AS opened, r.is_fix AS fixed, r.is_lock AS locked, r.voltage, r.current, r.power, r.energy, r.leakage, r.temperature, r.create_at, r.update_at, r.delete_at FROM circuit_break_record r WHERE r.device_id = #{device_id} AND r.delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.create_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.device_id, r.address, r.self_id, r.is_open AS opened, r.is_lock AS locked, r.create_at, r.update_at, r.delete_at FROM light_record r WHERE r.device_id = #{device_id} AND r.delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.create_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.device_id, r.address, r.self_id, r.temperature, r.humidity, r.light, r.smoke, r.create_at, r.update_at, r.delete_at FROM sensor_record r WHERE r.device_id = #{device_id} AND r.delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.create_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1
